opening_message:
Ticket 1: Jesus Cooke (employee ID E029) requests write access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E029.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist
  - employment type: contractor
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: HR record: Jesus Cooke (E029) is a contractor, role Payroll Specialist. As a contractor, access is limited to read unless advanced security training is documented; no training evidence in HR record. Recommend read (max) for Source Code request.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security record confirms E029 is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors may have write only with advanced training; basic training limits to read. Write request exceeds max, so recommend read.
reason: Jesus Cooke (E029) is a contractor with basic security training (not advanced). Per policy, contractors may have read, or write only with advanced security training. The requested write level exceeds the maximum allowed (read), so the maximum of read is granted.
